title: Mince and Tatie Pie
subtitle: A Northern English pie of minced beef and potato in a shortcrust case
excerpt: Minced beef and diced potato cooked in a savoury gravy, baked in a shortcrust case. A proper Northern English supper.
sourceNotes: Traditional Northern English working-class pie using minced beef and potato, sometimes called tatty pie.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze in slices once cooled. Reheat at 180C for 20 minutes from frozen.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: The filling can be made two days ahead and kept in the fridge.

content.text: This pie uses minced beef and diced potato cooked in a thick onion gravy. The potato softens fully in the filling before it goes into the pastry. Let the filling cool before assembling so the base stays crisp.

items.prepNote: two thirds for the base, one third for the lid

content.text: Heat the oil in the frying pan over a medium-high heat. Brown the mince in batches, breaking it up as it cooks. Set aside.
Reduce the heat and cook the onion and carrot in the same pan for 8 minutes until soft.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Return the mince to the pan. Add the stock, Worcestershire sauce and potato.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the gravy is thick and the potato is just tender. Season and leave to cool completely.
Heat the oven to 200C. Roll out two thirds of the pastry and line the pie dish. Pour in the cooled filling.
Roll the remaining pastry into a lid. Brush the rim with egg, press on the lid and crimp the edges. Brush the top with egg and cut two slits.
Bake for 35 minutes until the pastry is golden and firm. Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

items.symptom: The gravy is too thin inside the pie.
items.cause: The filling was not reduced enough before going in.
items.fix: Simmer the filling uncovered until the gravy coats a spoon thickly before you cool it.

items.symptom: The potato is still firm after baking.
items.cause: The potato cubes were too large or not cooked long enough on the hob.
items.fix: Cut potato cubes no larger than 1cm and simmer the filling for the full 20 minutes before assembling.

items.symptom: The base is soft and pale.
items.fix: Cool the filling completely in the fridge before lining the dish and filling the pie.
